LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_Autopistol.label: makeshift autopistol
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_Autopistol.description: An ancient autopistol repaired on the knee, with a suppressor and sight attached. Used for silent assassinations and subversive activities. Weak and ineffective, but cheap.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_MachinePistol.label: anarchist machine pistol
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_MachinePistol.description: A crudely modified machine pistol. A close-combat weapon, a stock was welded on and an extended magazine added.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_BoltActionRifle.label: anarchist bolt-action rifle
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_BoltActionRifle.description: A rifle modified by anarchists. They increased the magazine while keeping the original design and its lethality. An excellent weapon for hunting animals... And Imperials.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_PumpShotgun.label: worn pump shotgun
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_PumpShotgun.description: An old, slightly rotten shotgun that fires a stream of pellets. Deadly, but with short range.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_ChainShotgun.label: anarchist chain shotgun
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_ChainShotgun.description: A fully automatic, magazine-fed shotgun. The magazine was crudely enlarged, further increasing its rate of fire.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_HeavySMG.label: anarchist heavy SMG
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_HeavySMG.description: A compact heavy SMG. The stock and grip have been replaced with wooden ones, and the magazine has been enlarged.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_LMG.label: anarchist light machine gun
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_LMG.description: An anarchist light machine gun with an attached sight. Capable of suppressing the enemy with even greater accuracy.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_AssaultRifle.label: assault rifle
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_AssaultRifle.description: An assault rifle equipped with a sight, with the stock and grip replaced by wooden ones. More accurate, but also heavier.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_SniperRifle.label: anarchist sniper rifle
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_SniperRifle.description: A sniper rifle with a slightly misaligned scope, but a lightened stock. It fires less accurately, but weighs less.
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_Minigun.label: anarchist minigun
LanguageData.Anarchy_Gun_Minigun.description: A rapid-fire machine gun with a large ammo box attached... And a flag. At least it's stylish.
